ValidationRule.description: 仕様: Core 第11.4.2節。仕訳で両方選んだときはFromを共通部分だけ許す。
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(TargetObject__c, "GlJournal__c"), INCLUDES(Context__c, "LineJournal"), INCLUDES(Context__c, "NonLineJournal"), OR( ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "InvoiceLine__c"), ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "ContractProduct__c"), ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "Product2"), ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "InvoicePaymentAllocation__c") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 明細仕訳と明細外仕訳の両方を選ぶときは、共通のFromだけにしてください。
